name: Beijing Air Tiantan PM2.5 Time Series Dataset
description: Derived hourly air-quality and meteorological time series dataset for the Tiantan station from the Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality data collection at UCI. Source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/501/beijing+multi+site+air+quality+data. The record contains a canonical Parquet benchmark file and CSV mirror for forecasting and sensor-fault robustness evaluation. It retains the longest Tiantan segment selected by documented gap rules, contains no missing values or duplicate timestamps, and uses PM2.5 as the downstream forecast target.
rai:dataLimitations: Single-station Tiantan subset of a larger Beijing Air monitoring archive. The retained segment is selected by documented gap rules and remaining gaps are forward-filled only within the segment. The upstream UCI record states that meteorological variables are matched to each air-quality site from the nearest China Meteorological Administration weather station. The dataset is not recommended for health advice, regulatory decisions, or deployment without independent validation.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset has geographic and station-selection bias toward the Tiantan monitoring site. Gap-based trimming may underrepresent periods with extended sensor outages or source missingness. The wind-direction channel is integer-coded and should be treated as discrete rather than continuous.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or human-subject records are included. The data describe public environmental measurements and weather variables, not individuals.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for reproducible time series forecasting experiments and sensor-fault robustness benchmarking under the accompanying benchmark protocol. The packaged files do not include sensor-fault labels, corrupted samples, or faulted samples because sensor-fault scenarios are generated by the benchmark code during evaluation. It is not validated for public-health, operational, regulatory, or deployment use.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive use is transparent robustness evaluation for environmental time series forecasting. The main risk is overinterpreting benchmark results as environmental or health evidence.
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Derived from the Tiantan station source CSV by constructing hourly datetimes, splitting at PM2.5 gaps longer than 24 hours, splitting at non-target feature gaps longer than 72 hours, selecting the longest retained segment, forward-filling remaining gaps only inside that segment, trimming unresolved leading rows if needed, applying no backward fill, exporting the canonical Parquet file, and packaging it with a CSV mirror and SHA256 checksum manifest.
